title: SCHC fragmentation normative docs and Rust timeout constant contradict canonical behavior
description: Final Rule/version correctness review: draft-lichen-schc-lora-00 says ACK bitmap 1 means missing while nearby text and spec/03 say 1 means received; it labels 78c0 as W=0 although the wire encodes W=1,C=1. Rust exposes RETRANSMISSION_TIMEOUT_S=15 while constants.toml and specs say 10, appendix-schc says MAX_ACK=3 while canonical code/vectors say 4, and the draft repeats section heading 6. Adopt canonical 10-second timeout and 4 attempts across Rust/spec/appendix/vectors, correct bitmap/example wording and headings, and add executable parameter assertions so drift fails tests.
